title: Change's own pm-notes lacks the delivery_mode field it introduces (dogfooding gap)
description: This change was delivered autonomously and mandates that @pm record `delivery_mode` at intake in pm-notes (AC-F1-1, DoD). However, chg-GH-108-pm-notes.yaml has no top-level `delivery_mode` field — the only mention is inside a retro/decision note string. So the mode-aware rule would read `interactive` (default) for GH-108 itself. This does not break anything here (GH-108's feature area already has a spec, so phase 7 reconciles regardless of mode), but it is a cross-artifact consistency gap: the change does not demonstrate the very intake signal it ships.
suggestedFix: Add a top-level `delivery_mode: autonomous` line next to `change_id`/`title` in chg-GH-108-pm-notes.yaml to match the pm-notes structure documented in .opencode/agent/pm.md. Advisory only — does not affect any shipped prompt/script/spec.
